answer: Count the bill: the ocean opens 40 salvage permits an epoch, one per identity. A permit costs a 120-POA bond, +50 POA per extra identity from the same root, so ten linked fakes lock 3,450 POA. The dive is live: three key-signed recoveries in one 25-minute window, each announced two minutes ahead, and one operator can dive at most two permits at once. A missed dive burns 30 POA; the relic each diver surfaces is seeded by the epoch hash plus its own key, so no two fakes surface the same one. The jetty log checks dive minutes against funding roots: same-minute dives by one hand count as one.
